hero.description: Learn about our policies and actions to reduce emissions, manage waste responsibly, and monitor environmental performance throughout the operation.

heading.title: Seloasa Policies and Actions
heading.description: We integrate actions focused on operational efficiency, impact reduction, and compliance with guidelines that strengthen a responsible logistics operation.

gei.title: Policy for reducing greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions
gei.description: Objective: Promote the efficient and sustainable use of SELOASA transport fleet resources, reducing carbon footprint and improving operational efficiency through transport technologies.
gei.item_1: Seloasa integrated hybrid diesel-powered units into its fleet.
gei.item_2: Seloasa integrated multi-temperature cargo box units, managing different loads without using more than one unit.
gei.item_3: Obtaining the clean transport certification from SEMARNAT.
gei.item_4: Reducing engine idling through on-site solar-generated energy.
gei.item_5: Incorporating units with Euro VI standard engines to reduce NOX and PM emissions.

waste.title: Responsible Waste Management Policy
waste.description: Servicios Logísticos Alsera S.A. de C.V. (SELOASA) reaffirms its commitment as a socially responsible company, aligning with ECOVADIS, PSCI, and the K-15 initiative. It integrates REUSE - REDUCE - RECYCLE actions to minimize its environmental footprint.
waste.item_1: Reduce the amount of waste generated in all areas of the company.
waste.item_2: Reuse and recycle whenever possible; ensure proper and safe disposal.
waste.item_3: Applies to all employees, facilities, and vehicle fleet.
waste.item_4: The person responsible for this policy is the Head of Safety, Hygiene, and Environment.
waste.subtitle: JSHE Functions
waste.jshe_1: Identify waste, communicate criteria, and promote reuse and recycling.
waste.jshe_2: Implement environmental training and institutional awareness.
waste.jshe_3: Record and analyze data to optimize environmental management.
waste.jshe_4: Apply sanctions according to compliance with this policy.

report.title: Environmental Performance Report
report.description: As part of SELOASA's environmental commitment, we share the Performance Report validated by the Ministry of Environment and Natural Resources (SEMARNAT) for the year 2024.
